search_text: published ZDI-14-045 ZDI-CAN-1860 Apple QuickTime stsz Atom Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2014-04-03 CVE-2014-1244 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-1244 10.0 ['Apple'] ['QuickTime 7.3'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple QuickTime. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the stsz atom. By creating a deliberately malformed stsz atom, an attacker is able to cause a heap overflow within the QuickTime parser. Using this vulnerability, an attacker can execute arbitrary code in the context of the user. Apple has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: http://support.apple.com/kb/HT1222 ['2013-07-13 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2014-04-03 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Tom Gallagher & Paul Bates https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-14-045/

Using this vulnerability, an attacker can execute arbitrary code in the context of the user.
